panelAudit.survivorshipWarning: SH/SZ membership includes listings and delistings whose lifetime overlaps 2019 onward. Historical ST and trading status are enforced per bar. BJ is excluded because equivalent PIT status coverage is unavailable.

fundamentalAudit.availabilityRule: first market date strictly after max(noticeDate, updateDate)
fundamentalAudit.restatementLimitation: The public endpoint exposes the currently retrievable statement version; historical restatement vintages may be incomplete. Using UPDATE_DATE is conservative but cannot reconstruct unavailable old vintages.

earnings_volume_confirmation.mechanism: A newly disclosed earnings improvement is more informative when same-session trading activity confirms that investors noticed it.

growth_momentum_confirmation.mechanism: Growth acceleration combined with positive medium-horizon price diffusion is a constrained post-announcement-drift hypothesis.

quality_low_volatility.mechanism: High operating quality with low realised volatility may distinguish durable quality from speculative quality.

cash_quality_reversal.mechanism: Cash-supported profitability after a short price drawdown is a constrained quality-at-temporary-discount hypothesis.
